== Description ==

Three attendees talking near the refreshment counter at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Taylor Gosiaco]] (right, dark denim jacket and glasses) and [[Apollo Chu]] (far right background, green-and-white sweatshirt); two other attendees unlabeled.
